description: Provides access to various static and dynamic lookup data and lists of entities such as currencies, countries, application types, partners, contacts, and users.

endpoints.name: GetCurrencies
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all available currencies.
example_uses: How can I get a list of all supported currencies?
Show me the available currency codes.
I need to see all currency options.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need a comprehensive list of currencies for selection or reference.

endpoints.name: GetEligibleEntities
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of entities that are eligible for certain operations or classifications.
example_uses: What are the eligible entities?
List all entities that qualify.
I need to know which entities are eligible.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to identify entities that meet specific eligibility criteria.

endpoints.name: GetCountries
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all countries.
example_uses: Can you give me a list of all countries?
Show me the country codes.
I need to select a country from a list.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need a comprehensive list of countries for selection or reference.

endpoints.name: GetApplicationTypes
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all available application types.
example_uses: What are the different application types?
List all available application categories.
I need to know the types of applications.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to identify the various types of applications supported by the system.

endpoints.name: GetPartners
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all partners.
example_uses: Can I get a list of all partners?
Show me the registered partners.
I need to see all partner organizations.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need a general list of all partners, typically for lookup or display purposes.

endpoints.name: GetOrganizationUnits
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all organizational units.
example_uses: What are the organizational units?
List all departments.
I need to see the structure of the organization.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need a list of internal organizational units for categorization or assignment.

endpoints.name: GetContacts
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all contacts.
example_uses: Can I get a list of all contacts?
Show me the registered contacts.
I need to see all contact persons.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need a general list of all contacts, typically for lookup or display purposes.

endpoints.name: GetUsers
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all users.
example_uses: Can I get a list of all users?
Show me the registered system users.
I need to see all active users.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need a general list of all system users, typically for lookup or display purposes.

endpoints.name: GetGeminiModels
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of available Gemini AI models.
example_uses: What Gemini models are available?
List all AI models.
I need to know which Gemini models I can use.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to identify the available Gemini AI models for integration or use.
